stages.title: Confirm the scale-up contract
stages.purpose: Ask only the crucial role, authority, sensitive-data, concurrency and provider questions, with Bob recommendations.
stopConditions: A role or authority boundary is unclear
Peak concurrency has no stated assumption
The owner has not accepted the product contract

stages.title: Freeze accepted prototype behaviour
stages.purpose: Write unit, integration and Playwright journeys for accepted behaviour without turning known prototype defects into requirements.
stopConditions: An accepted journey has no meaningful test
A test expectation conflicts with the accepted product contract

stages.title: Build the serious local product
stages.purpose: Use reviewed blocks and contracts to build frontend, backend, identity, authority, data and reliability controls.
stopConditions: Required building block or provider adapter is missing
A valid characterization test regresses

stages.title: Prove deterministic local assurance
stages.purpose: Render the exact-revision test, role, database, route, scanner, coverage and migration results before load.
stopConditions: An applicable check is missing, error, partial or stale
A migration is destructive, irreversible, privilege-expanding or unknown and H3 is not approved

stages.title: Explore experience and adversarial paths
stages.purpose: After deterministic assurance, use bounded synthetic personas to explore usability and unexpected authorization paths that fixed Playwright journeys may miss.
stopConditions: Deterministic assurance is not sufficiently complete
The target, identities or exploration limits are not declared
An observation is presented as a validated finding without reproduction and authority-contract evidence

stages.title: Review the local load plan
stages.purpose: Show the stable numbered traffic bundle, data volume, concurrency, duration, cost ceiling and fault boundaries without generating traffic.
stopConditions: Security is not passing
The owner has not approved the exact bounded load bundle

stages.title: Run bounded local load and recovery
stages.purpose: Run the approved normal, peak, spike, race, pressure and recovery scenarios against isolated local dependencies.
stopConditions: The approved load-plan digest changed
Capacity, denial or recovery thresholds fail

stages.title: Confirm hosted providers and residency
stages.purpose: Reuse prototype provider choices, prefer Singapore and show options and controls when Singapore is unavailable.
stopConditions: Provider identity, region, credential scope or cost is unknown
An overseas exception is not approved

stages.title: Bind and authorize synthetic staging
stages.purpose: Bind the provider account, team, project, environment, immutable staging target and clean exact source revision before any deployment mutation.
stopConditions: The account, team, project, environment or immutable target is unknown
The source is dirty or differs from the approved exact revision
The H4 staging decision is missing, stale or bound to another plan

stages.title: Deploy and prove immutable staging identity
stages.purpose: Deploy only the approved exact revision, record the provider deployment ID and prove that /health/version reports the same revision before any browser, load or security gate runs.
stopConditions: Provider output has not been privately captured, redacted and scanned
A token or secret is exposed and has not been revoked and rotated
The immutable deployment ID is missing
/health/version does not equal the approved exact revision

stages.title: Run exact-deployment synthetic staging gates
stages.purpose: Run migration, browser, security, load, failure, recovery, rollback and cleanup checks only against the deployment whose health revision was proven equal.
stopConditions: Deployment identity or /health/version evidence is missing, stale or mismatched
Synthetic data or test residue is outside the cleanup scope
Any applicable hosted check is not passing

stages.title: Prove production and monitoring readiness
stages.purpose: Show every production connection, missing human setup, monitoring signal, canary, rollback and residual risk before release.
stopConditions: A production-only prefix or environment branch lacks deterministic local proof
The fresh-production migration manifest is not exact-byte bound or the target is not empty
An old target is excluded only by name instead of immutable ID
The H5 approval was withdrawn, superseded, consumed or changed
A required production or monitoring connection is unknown
Staging evidence is stale
The owner has not accepted residual risk and release scope

stages.title: Release the approved production canary
stages.purpose: After readiness evidence is complete, obtain an exact-evidence H5 decision, release only the approved revision and verify health, authenticated journeys, denial, logging and rollback.
stopConditions: The H5 decision is no longer current and unconsumed
The H5 decision or revision binding drifted
The runtime identity schema is invalid or an available binding differs
Evidence is not one atomically written valid JSON document
Any canary or rollback check fails

stages.title: Operate the product
stages.purpose: Show product-filtered health, usage, concurrency, queues, errors, costs, backups, provider drift and new setup items.
stopConditions: Required telemetry has no retained data and is presented as zero
An outage or material drift is unacknowledged

humanGates.title: Product roles and authority
questions: What may each role see, create, change and delete?
What concurrency and peak usage should it support?
suggestions: Use a stated conservative peak when usage is uncertain

humanGates.title: Provider, region, credentials and cost
questions: Do the detected prototype providers remain correct?
Which overseas option is acceptable when Singapore is unavailable?
Are the scoped credential names and cost ceiling correct?
suggestions: Prefer Singapore for configurable data destinations
Reuse the prototype provider only when its authority and data boundaries remain suitable
Never place credential values in the decision artifact

humanGates.title: Risky data or permission change
questions: Who gains or loses access in plain language?
Is any data rewritten or removed?
suggestions: Use expand, migrate, verify and contract
Apply automatically only to a disposable local database
Delay destructive contraction until the new path has been observed

humanGates.title: Hosted staging and failure testing
questions: Is this exact revision and provider account, team, project, environment and immutable target correct?
Are the synthetic identities, load shapes, failure injections, costs and cleanup scope acceptable?
suggestions: Use synthetic users and an approved staging inbox
Keep the campaign bounded and authenticated

humanGates.title: Production and residual risk
questions: Do you accept this exact readiness evidence and residual-risk set?
Are real users, data, privacy, retention, DNS and billing approved?
Are the canary and rollback boundaries acceptable?
suggestions: Never substitute staging credentials or evidence
Bind the decision to the final readiness evidence digests
Keep production monitoring separate and product-filterable

confirmations.title: Approve the deterministic local load bundle
